_: Planted red/green controls linked by GROUP marker to the spawned tests that drive the pre-commit lock guard's exit code.

expectRed: exits 1 naming plan-critic when the review-gate lock exists
resolves the main checkout lock from a worktree
exits 1 when the lock sits under REVIEW_GATE_ROOT, not the checkout
mutations.note: The lock branch prints its reason and exits 0 — a commit lands while a review round is open, which is the defect this guard exists to stop. Also reddens the REVIEW_GATE_ROOT test, since that path reaches the same blocking exit.

expectRed: exits 0 when no review-gate lock exists
mutations.note: The clean path blocks too — every commit is refused whether or not a round is open.

expectRed: exits 1 naming plan-critic when the review-gate lock exists
resolves the main checkout lock from a worktree
mutations.note: Resolves the checkout's own toplevel instead of the shared common dir. `dirname` then points one level ABOVE the repository, so no lock is found in either case: the main checkout stops gating too, not only the worktree.

expectRed: exits 1 naming the common dir when run outside a git repository
mutations.note: An unresolvable git common dir ALLOWS the commit instead of refusing it. The sibling `no-common-dir` mutation reaches this catch but pins only the lock-check tests, so this exit code was ungraded — flipping it left the suite 3/3 green, which an accidental sed in round 5 proved on the real tree.

expectRed: exits 1 when the lock sits under REVIEW_GATE_ROOT, not the checkout
mutations.note: The guard stops consulting REVIEW_GATE_ROOT while review-gate.js still WRITES the lock there, so the two halves of one gate look in different places and a commit passes with a round open.
